summary.text: Evan Vickers is a Republican state senator from Utah who has represented District 28 since 2013 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pharmacist and drug store owner, he has served as Senate majority leader since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Evan Vickers earned a B.S. in pharmacy from the University of Utah in 1977.
He worked as a pharmacy manager for Albertson's from 1985 to 1996 and has been president and owner of Bulloch's Drug Store since 1996.
Vickers served on the Cedar City Council from 1987 to 1999 and in the Utah House of Representatives, District 72, from 2009 to 2013, before joining the Senate in 2013.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Government Operations and Political Subdivisions, Health and Human Services, and Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment committees.
